You’re not alone in this, even if it feels that way. But it also creates an almost unbearable loneliness, because it separates you from everyone you love, including your parents, even though they may be expressing their concern in a clumsy and judgmental way.

The real challenge is to see the same divine spark in *everyone*, even those who seem asleep. That's much harder, but it's also what actually brings connection.
